idea-plugin.name: Email Footer Law Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Fourteen checks on an HTML email footer: CAN-SPAM postal address and 10-business-day opt-out, CASL's 60-day window, and German 5 DDG, the statute that replaced 5 TMG on 2024-05-14.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Email Footer Law Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/email-footer-law-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/email-footer-law-lint

action.text: Email Footer Law Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Email Footer Law Lint on the file in the editor
